=== slash
--- before
¦foo bar baz
--- keys
/ba<CR>
--- after
foo ¦bar baz

=== slash n
--- before
¦foo bar baz
--- keys
/ba<CR>n
--- after
foo bar ¦baz

=== slash wraps
--- before
foo bar b¦az
--- keys
/foo<CR>
--- after
¦foo bar baz

=== question
--- before
foo bar ¦baz
--- keys
?foo<CR>
--- after
¦foo bar baz

=== question n
--- before
a x b x c ¦x
--- keys
?x<CR>n
--- after
a ¦x b x c x

=== question N
--- before
a x b x c ¦x
--- keys
?x<CR>N
--- after
a x b x c ¦x

=== slash regex
--- before
¦foo1 bar22 baz
--- keys
/\d\+<CR>n
--- after
foo1 bar¦22 baz

=== slash word bound
--- before
¦this is
--- keys
/\<lt>is<CR>
--- after
this ¦is

=== slash very magic
--- before
¦ab aab xaab
--- keys
/\v(a)+b<CR>n
--- after
ab aab x¦aab

=== slash dollar
--- before
¦xa
bx
x
--- keys
/x$<CR>
--- after
xa
b¦x
x

=== slash caret
--- before
¦ax
xb
--- keys
/^x<CR>
--- after
ax
¦xb

=== slash empty reuses
--- before
¦a x b x c
--- keys
/x<CR>0/<CR>
--- after
a ¦x b x c

=== slash with count
--- before
¦a x b x c x
--- keys
2/x<CR>
--- after
a x b ¦x c x

=== d slash
--- before
¦foo bar baz
--- keys
d/baz<CR>
--- after
¦baz

=== c slash
--- before
¦foo bar baz
--- keys
c/bar<CR>X<Esc>
--- after
¦Xbar baz

=== y slash +reg
--- before
¦foo bar baz
--- keys
y/baz<CR>
--- after
¦foo bar baz
[reg v] "foo bar "

=== visual slash
--- before
¦foo bar baz
--- keys
v/baz<CR>
--- after
«foo bar b»az
[visual]

=== slash escape cancels
--- before
¦foo bar
--- keys
/bar<Esc>
--- after
¦foo bar

=== slash backspace
--- before
¦foo bar baz
--- keys
/bax<BS>r<CR>
--- after
foo ¦bar baz

=== slash not found
--- before
¦foo bar
--- keys
/zzz<CR>
--- after
¦foo bar

=== star then slash n
--- before
¦foo bar foo
--- keys
*n
--- after
¦foo bar foo

=== slash offset ignored
--- before
¦foo bar
--- keys
/bar/e<CR>
--- after
foo ba¦r

=== slash case
--- before
¦foo Foo foo
--- keys
/Foo<CR>
--- after
foo ¦Foo foo

=== slash multiline
--- before
¦ab
cd
--- keys
/b\nc<CR>
--- after
a¦b
cd

=== slash class
--- before
¦a1 b2
--- keys
/[0-9]<CR>n
--- after
a1 b¦2

=== search zs
--- before
¦foobar foobaz
--- keys
/foo\zsbaz<CR>
--- after
foobar foo¦baz

=== search ze
--- before
¦foobar foobaz
--- keys
/foo\zebaz<CR>
--- after
foobar ¦foobaz

=== search zs n
--- before
¦xab xab xab
--- keys
/x\zsab<CR>n
--- after
xab x¦ab xab

=== search zs backward
--- before
foobar foob¦az
--- keys
?foo\zsbar<CR>
--- after
foo¦bar foobaz
